title: Many Pixels, One Composition: Self-Supervised Spectra for Specimen-Level Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.06096v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Can hyperspectral (HS) imaging be used to predict the elemental composition of physical specimens found on the Earth's surface? We approach this problem as a supervised regression task, using an open dataset of specimens, each comprising a HS cube and elemental characterization. In particular, we train an encoder in a self-supervised fashion that operates on pixel-level; then freeze the encoder and train a lightweight attention-based regression head in a supervised manner, by pairing many representations of a given specimen with its corresponding elemental label. In test specimens, our approach significantly outperforms traditional spectral matching and unmixing baselines. It also outperforms supervised learning models based on the mean spectrum (of similar model capacity), while full model fine-tuning achieves the strongest performance, at substantially higher model capacity.

translated_title: 多像素，单一成分：面向样本级预测的自监督光谱方法
translated_abstract: 高光谱（HS）成像能否用于预测地球表面所发现的物理样本的元素成分？我们将该问题视为一个监督回归任务，使用一个开放的样本数据集，其中每个样本由一个高光谱立方体和元素表征组成。具体而言，我们以自监督方式训练一个在像素级别运行的编码器；随后冻结该编码器，并以监督方式训练一个轻量级的基于注意力的回归头，方法是将给定样本的多个表征与其对应的元素标签进行配对。在测试样本上，我们的方法显著优于传统的光谱匹配和解混基线方法。同时，它也优于基于平均光谱的监督学习模型（模型容量相近），而完整模型的微调则以大幅更高的模型容量取得了最佳性能。
tldr: 该论文提出一种自监督像素级编码器结合轻量级注意力回归头的方法，从高光谱成像预测地球表面物理样本的元素成分，在保持较低模型容量的情况下显著优于传统光谱匹配、解混及基于平均光谱的监督学习基线。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a self-supervised pixel-level encoder paired with a lightweight attention-based regression head to predict the elemental composition of Earth surface specimens from hyperspectral imaging, significantly outperforming traditional spectral matching, unmixing, and mean-spectrum supervised baselines at much lower model capacity.
